Introducing the Creamy Lemonade Latte — bright, zesty, dreamy, and made with our Prebiotic Mango Lemon Balm blend 🌿

it’s giving pool day. it’s giving lemonade stand. it’s giving what am i drinking and why is it so good 🤎

the recipe 👇
* 2 tbsp Teeccino Prebiotic Mango Lemon Balm (brewed strong + chilled)
* ½ cup fresh lemonade 🍋
* 2 tbsp coconut cream or oat milk 🥥
* 1–2 tsp honey or maple 🍯
* ice 🧊
* garnish with lemon + fresh mint 🌿

shake, pour over ice, sip in the sun ✨

caffeine-free · gut-loving · basically summer in a glass 🤎

🌿 THE INGREDIENT DISCOVERY THAT CHANGED EVERYTHING 🌿 Some ingredients find you when you least expect it. ✨

Caroline shares the story of how she discovered the ramon seed—an ancient Mayan superfood that became the heart of our Mayan family blends. This isn’t just a product story. It’s a journey through history, tradition, and a deep respect for the wisdom of indigenous cultures. 🌎

One seed. Centuries of heritage. A whole new chapter for Teeccino. ☕️💛

This is the magic that happens when you travel the world with an open heart and a mission to bring the best ingredients home to your cup. 🌱

no bc this banana coffee slushy is unserious 🍌🧊🤎

meet your new summer obsession — a French Roast + frozen banana slushy that’s giving frappuccino but make it functional 🌿

the recipe 👇
* 1 tbsp Instant French Roast Teeccino
* 1 frozen banana 🍌
* ½ cup oat milk (or milk of choice)
* 1 tsp maple syrup (optional)
* 1 cup ice 🧊
* blend till slushy ✨
* top with foam + a dusting of cinnamon 🌰

caffeine-free · creamy · dessert-coded 🤎
